summary: Expand rectangular coil records into weighted filaments, evaluate each coil response, and superpose the drive currents. The named fields are returned in one scirel._result.Result mapping.

capability: Expand rectangular coil records into weighted filaments, evaluate each coil response and superpose the drive currents.
operation: rectangular-coil records and target grid -> vacuum fields and filament table
discovery.model: Ordered acyclic composition of rectangular geometry, circular Green response and current contraction.
discovery.geometry: Matching nonempty rectilinear target grid and nonempty ordered coil list; response matrices have target rows and caller-ordered coil columns. Active nonzero-current filament coincidences with target nodes are rejected.
discovery.boundary: Input validation, an active filament/target coincidence, or any dependency failure aborts the call without a fallback or partial field.

identity.direction: rectangular-coil records and target grid to vacuum fields and filament table
identity.definition: Discretize each caller coil, attach filament weights, and evaluate its target-ordered Green response. Each coil's drive is the per-filament current (current_a, or ampere_turns_a divided by the sum of the coil's weights). Stack the responses as [N_target,N_coil] matrices with one coil per column, contract the [N_coil] drive-current vector along axis 1, and reshape to the input grid. The documented fields are returned together in a scirel._result.Result mapping; mapping and attribute access expose the same values. No nested mapping is returned.
identity.model: Ordered acyclic composition of rectangular geometry, circular Green response, and current contraction.
identity.geometry: Matching nonempty rectilinear target grid and nonempty ordered coil list; response matrices have target rows and caller-ordered coil columns.
identity.coordinates: Grid and coil geometry in metres; current_a is amperes per filament, ampere_turns_a is amperes per coil; output psi Wb/rad and fields tesla.
identity.boundary: Input validation, an active filament/target coincidence, or any dependency failure aborts the call without a fallback or partial field.
assumptions: Target grids are finite, matching and nonempty, and their R and Z axes are strictly increasing; singleton axes are permitted.
Each coil mapping has the required finite fields and optional weights/angle.
No active nonzero-current filament exactly coincides with a target grid node.
Returned filament rows preserve coil and within-coil order.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.constraints: Finite nonempty rectilinear 2-D grid; radial axis is strictly increasing and nonnegative. N_R and N_Z are each at least one.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.constraints: Finite, nonempty, same shape as r_grid, and axial axis strictly increasing; singleton axes are permitted.

inputs.name: rectangular_coils
inputs.description: Coil mappings with r0_m,z0_m,nr,nz,dr_m,dz_m, exactly one of current_a or ampere_turns_a, and optional angle_deg/weights. current_a is the current in EACH filament (filament j carries current_a*weights[j]; weights default to 1, so a coil's total ampere-turns are nr*nz*current_a). ampere_turns_a is the total current of the whole coil block, split over its filaments in proportion to weights. Passing a coil's total ampere-turns as current_a makes its field nr*nz times too large. Active nonzero-current filaments must not be exactly coincident with a target grid node.
inputs.constraints: Nonempty; each coil gives exactly one finite current_a or ampere_turns_a (both or neither raise ValueError) and optionally one finite weight per generated filament; ampere_turns_a needs weights with a nonzero sum. A nonzero-current, nonzero-weight filament coincident with a target grid node raises ValueError.

outputs.name: psi_vac
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Vacuum poloidal flux on the target grid.
outputs.constraints: Same grid shape and C-order point mapping as inputs.

outputs.name: b_r_vac
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Vacuum radial magnetic field on the target grid.
outputs.constraints: Same grid shape and C-order point mapping as inputs.

outputs.name: b_z_vac
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Vacuum axial magnetic field on the target grid.
outputs.constraints: Same grid shape and C-order point mapping as inputs.

outputs.name: filaments
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: Concatenated [R_m,Z_m,weight] rows in caller coil order.
outputs.constraints: Preserves each coil's filament order and the outer caller coil order.

preconditions: Target grids are finite, matching and nonempty, and their R and Z axes are strictly increasing; singleton axes are permitted.
Each coil mapping has the required finite fields and optional weights/angle.
No active nonzero-current filament exactly coincides with a target grid node.
supported: One or more rectangular coils, optional weights/rotation, C-order reshaping, and dependency failure propagation.
Exact active filament/target coincidences fail closed; zero-current or zero-weight filaments remain inactive.
excluded: Iterative coil solving, nonlinear materials, finite-wire effects, and malformed/empty coil lists.
Line-current self-field regularization at an exact filament/target coincidence.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: TypeError when a required argument is missing, the removed mapping or **kwargs form is used, or an unknown keyword is supplied. ValueError is raised for empty or malformed grids, empty/nonmapping coils, invalid geometry, weights, currents, or an active filament exactly coincident with a target grid node.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency ValueError/FloatingPointError propagates before any field is returned, including a nonrepresentable current-weighted Green contraction; no fallback or retry is performed.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; the graph has no feedback loop.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No scirel._result.Result field or filament output is returned after a failed graph stage.

example.description: Expand one 2x2 rectangular coil on a 2x2 target grid and evaluate its vacuum field.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel._result import Result
from scirel.field import solve_multi_coil_vacuum_field
r_grid, z_grid = np.meshgrid([0.0, 0.2], [-0.1, 0.1])
result = solve_multi_coil_vacuum_field(
    r_grid=r_grid,
    z_grid=z_grid,
    rectangular_coils=[{
        'r0_m': 0.45, 'z0_m': 0.0, 'nr': 2, 'nz': 2,
        'dr_m': 0.04, 'dz_m': 0.05, 'current_a': 1000.0,
    }],
)
assert isinstance(result, Result)
assert list(result) == [
    'psi_vac', 'b_r_vac', 'b_z_vac', 'filaments'
]
assert result.psi_vac is result['psi_vac']
assert result['psi_vac'].shape == r_grid.shape
assert result['filaments'].shape == (4, 3)
assert np.isfinite(result['b_z_vac']).all()
example.expected: The three field arrays have shape (2,2), the returned filament table has shape (4,3), and b_z_vac is finite. The returned object is a scirel._result.Result mapping; each field is also readable as an attribute.

scope: Explicit public signature with three required positional-or-keyword physical inputs; legacy mapping, inputs keyword and unknown keyword calls raise TypeError.
Linear scaling with coil drive current.
Independent response columns for multiple coils, aligned with the drive-current vector along axis 1.
Missing-current and empty-grid failures, with nonempty singleton-axis grids retained.
Unrepresentable near-wire or high-current responses fail closed instead of returning nonfinite fields.
Fixed Pleiades two-coil reference values and the full 9x9 truth arrays are covered by tests/cross_domain/multi_coil_vacuum_field/test_pleiades_two_coil_truth.py using the tracked domain fixture.
scripts/build_pleiades_truth.py writes only an explicitly named candidate from a caller-supplied source checkout; it never overwrites the tracked fixture or vendors source.
Per-filament current_a versus total ampere_turns_a: both forms give the same field, a single filament matches the on-axis loop formula, and both or neither raise ValueError.
Active filament/target exact coincidences are rejected, while zero-weight coincidences remain inactive.
The named result preserves the captured key order, values, shapes, dtypes, mapping access and attribute access; failures retain their exception types and messages.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to linear multi-coil vacuum field and Green response columns with independent coil currents. Evidence: `test_composition_multi_coil_vacuum_field.py` exercises independent coil-column responses, current scaling, empty-grid rejection and singleton-axis acceptance; `test_pleiades_two_coil_truth.py` contains 4 test functions, 2 of which reference `solve_multi_coil_vacuum_field`, and is bound only by this asset; the bounded example was executed by this audit. Oracle: the tracked Pleiades simple-two-coil fixture (`tests/fixtures/multi_coil_vacuum_field/pleiades_simple_two_coil`) and its provenance; the full 9x9 arrays are compared on every run. It does not establish iterative coil solving, nonlinear materials, finite-wire effects, or malformed/empty coil lists. The coincidence regression covers exact active and inactive filament cases only; finite-wire self-field behavior remains outside scope.
known_limitations: No field cache or device object is kept between calls.
No feedback, optimization, or conductor-material model is included.
The fixed Pleiades spot references and full-array comparison run on every test invocation; malformed/empty coil lists remain excluded.
Exact active filament/target coincidences are rejected rather than regularized as finite-wire self fields.

nodes.description: Iterate caller coil mappings and expose one validated parameter set in caller order, with the per-filament current taken from current_a or derived from ampere_turns_a.
Append dimensionless filament weights and preserve one coil drive current.
Pack matching rectilinear grids into C-order R-Z target rows.
Evaluate one target-ordered Green response vector for the current coil block.
Stack one completed target-ordered response vector per coil as a column of each [N_target,N_coil] matrix, preserving the aligned [N_coil] drive-current vector without multiplication.
Contract the drive-current vector with the coil columns of each [N_target,N_coil] response matrix along axis 1.
Concatenate weighted filament blocks only for the returned diagnostic table.

execution.ordering: Validate the nonempty grids and coil records, discretize all coils in caller order, evaluate each target-ordered Green response independently, column-stack the responses as [N_target,N_coil], contract currents along axis 1 once, and reshape outputs.
execution.state_ownership: Caller owns grid and coil declarations; the graph owns only local ordered lists for the current call and retains no mutable state.
execution.failure_propagation: Validation or dependency failure aborts the call immediately; no fallback, retry, or partial field result is produced.
